page.overview:
What is Carrot on a Stick?

A carrot on a stick is an item that can be used to control saddled pigs.

It is possible to craft a carrot on a stick without a crafting table.

To use a carrot on a stick, the player must first saddle a pig, and ride it while holding the carrot on a stick. The pig then moves in the direction of the carrot. Also, if the player holds a carrot on a stick, all nearby pigs (but not rabbits) follow the player, but they can't breed using carrot on a stick.

To make the pig run faster, the player can press while holding the carrot on a stick. This is called "boosting". Each boost costs 7 durability. If the carrot on a stick's durability is depleted, it turns back into a fishing rod.
